# Symmetries

Source: [`Kernel/Symmetries.wl`](../../Kernel/Symmetries.wl) · Design notes: [MODULES.md](../MODULES.md#symmetries-kernelsymmetrieswl--declaresymmetries)

DeclareSymmetries: classify every monomial (I w)^m (q^2)^n of every Gamma2 entry up to the truncation orders as declared / Protected / Neglected / vanishing by structure, before any flow is computed. Objective, assumptions and checks: docs/MODULES.md section "Symmetries".

## Symbols

### `DeclareSymmetries`

`DeclareSymmetries[ansatz, tags..., "TruncationOrders" -> <|"Frequency" -> mf, "Momentum" -> mp|>]` classifies every monomial (I w)^m (q^2)^n, m &lt;= mf, n &lt;= mp, of every Gamma2 entry. Tags: `Protected[pairPattern, opts]`, `Neglected[pairPattern, opts]`, `NonRenormalised[coupling, "Reason" -> ...]`. Precedence: Protected > declared > Neglected; an untagged monomial aborts. Returns the "Symmetries" stage.

### `Neglected`

`Neglected[pairPattern, "Frequency" -> m | {m..} | All, "Momentum" -> n | {n..} | All, "Reason" -> text]`: the flow of these monomials is computed and reported as a warning, then dropped.

### `NonRenormalised`

`NonRenormalised[coupling, "Reason" -> text]`: a vertex coupling assumed not to flow (not checkable in v1: needs d\_s Gamma3).

### `ShowClassification`

`ShowClassification[symmetries]` prints the classification table of all monomials.

### `MonomialClasses`

Classes of a monomial: "Declared" (equation), "DeclaredNumeric" (numeric coefficient: flow must vanish), "Protected" (flow must vanish), "Neglected" (flow reported), "Causality" (Gamma\_{phi phi}: flow must vanish), "Structure" (odd frequency power of a diagonal entry: vanishes identically, not computed).
